asked.item: Why every TikTok video gets very few views

verdict.reason: The TikTok FAQ explains what consistently very low views mean and what it recommends.

steps.text: If your views are consistently under 50, the page says something is wrong with your account.
If you have 10 videos in a row that all have under 50 views, your account is likely shadowbanned.
The page recommends starting fresh with a new account.
